about:
Asheville Thermoform Plastics was founded in October 1998 by Bill Trometer in a 2,400-square-foot incubator facility in Fletcher, North Carolina. The family-owned and operated company began with a focus on dunnage and thin-gauge packaging trays made using hand-made molds and fixtures.

Today the firm provides custom thermoforming services for both thin- and heavy-gauge plastics from a 15,000-square-foot building on five acres. Its capabilities include thermoforming, rapid prototyping, 3D printing, 5-axis CNC routing, design and engineering with reverse engineering, SolidWorks and AutoCAD drafting, and in-house tooling fabrication. The company specializes in low-to-medium volume production runs and handles projects from prototype through full production.

The shop serves a range of industries, with communications, medical, and construction called out specifically. Customers span a broad spectrum of markets, and the company emphasizes that design, tooling, prototypes, and full production runs are all available under one roof to keep lead times short.

The business was started after recognizing a need for custom plastic thermoforming services in the Southeast. A second generation of the family is now positioning the company for growth, and the firm notes that its minimum order quantity is one, allowing single-part orders.
